faq.answer: Doctor scheduling software is a tool used to build and manage physician and resident schedules. Most options are self-service platforms that require significant training and manual input. Scheduling Wizard differs by operating as a fully managed service; your program submits its rules and receive finished schedules, built to your rules, as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you, with no software to install or learn. Your team gets the output, not the workload.
faq.question: What is doctor scheduling software and how does Scheduling Wizard differ?

faq.answer: For a residency or fellowship we build the ACGME requirements in as the schedule is created: the 80-hour weekly limit, minimum rest, the 24-hour cap, and the specialty-specific Program Requirements. We work from the requirements your program tells us apply, and we redraft when something needs to change.
faq.question: How do you handle ACGME requirements for my specialty?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard generates Block and rotation schedules, Call schedules with fairness optimization, Clinic schedules, and Attending schedules. All schedule types are optimized simultaneously so that changes in one automatically resolve dependencies in the others, eliminating the manual cross-schedule patching that burdens chief residents and coordinators.
faq.question: What types of schedules does Scheduling Wizard generate?

faq.answer: Yes. Scheduling Wizard handles the schedule building, while many clients continue using the platform they already have for day-to-day schedule access. The finished schedules are delivered as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you that are ready to upload directly into your existing viewing platform, so you do not need to change your current workflow for accessing schedules.
faq.question: Can Scheduling Wizard work alongside your existing platform?

faq.answer: With most doctor scheduling software, annual chief turnover means starting from scratch. With Scheduling Wizard, your program's rules and requests are written down and kept year over year. Incoming chiefs inherit the written rule set and last year's schedule instead of rebuilding institutional knowledge from a blank spreadsheet.
faq.question: What happens to our scheduling setup when a new chief resident takes over?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard serves chief residents, chief fellows, program directors, program coordinators, GME offices, and department chairs at medical residency and fellowship programs. It is currently active across 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices. We also build for private practice administrators and managing partners who need physician scheduling without the burden of operating complex software.

items.title: Compliance Built Into Every Schedule
highlights: Home call and rest rules covered
items.description: We build each schedule to the rules that govern it. For a group or practice it means yours: coverage minimums, call equity, contractual obligations, time off and requests, and multiple sites where a group has them.
